rfcs.name: harness-plugins
rfcs.description: RFC — ship optional first-party Claude Code and Codex plugins as thin lifecycle adapters over stable afs hook commands, improving orientation and memory capture without making AgentsFS depend on any harness.

rfcs.name: rfc-artifact-sharing
rfcs.description: RFC for AgentsFS Hub — capability share links, comments, and pretty HTML export for individual documents, with the honest files-vs-DB argument and a contract-vs-Hub split.

rfcs.name: rfc-composio-connectors
rfcs.description: Should myexpert.ai adopt Composio as the connector/auth layer for expert agents, or build on Eve's native connections primitive — researched July 2026

rfcs.name: rfc-expert-portfolio
rfcs.description: The expert portfolio for myexpert.ai — which experts to build, their utility, their proactivity design, a worked health-expert deep-dive, and the shared platform capabilities the portfolio forces.

rfcs.name: rfc-expert-ux
rfcs.description: The per-expert UX for myexpert.ai — what a user sees when they open their expert, grounded in the running Boswell instance, with wireframes, image-gen prompts, and a homepage mock.

rfcs.name: rfc-imessage
rfcs.description: Evaluate paths to add iMessage as a proactive-digest + two-way-chat delivery channel for myexpert.ai experts, alongside the existing Telegram webhook channel

rfcs.name: rfc-phone-calling
rfcs.description: Phone calling via Twilio (or alternatives) for myexpert.ai — talk to your expert on an actual phone call, inbound and proactive outbound.

rfcs.name: rfc-source-problem
rfcs.description: The source problem — discovery, access, evaluation, and resilience of expert intake, treated as the product moat rather than plumbing. Decomposes intake into four loops, designs the access-recipe playbook as a factory asset, and sequences what ships this week vs. factory-side vs. the autonomous-wiring flow.

rfcs.name: rfc-whitelabel-layers
rfcs.description: Strategy for making AgentsFS / Hub / Eve integration so clean that platform improvements propagate into myexpert.ai automatically — the fork-to-library seam, Hub white-labeling, a propagation test against three real improvements, a low-disruption sequence, and why the end-state diff is the expert-factory's spec schema.

rfcs.name: rfc-hq-kb
rfcs.description: The HQ knowledge base as built — seekinggradient-hq, the thin router that holds whole-system knowledge over federated per-project KBs. Records the design-as-shipped, the router discipline, the HQ-vs-project membership test, the "part of" back-pointer convention, and why it is not a mega-KB. Companion to rfc-portfolio-architecture.

rfcs.name: rfc-madeweb
rfcs.description: What madeweb actually is (a Cloudflare-native agent-publishing host for single-page interactive HTML), its live-but-dormant deployment and bug state, and the honest integrate-vs-mine-and-freeze decision for its role as the portfolio's INTERACTIVE-artifact organ. Both branches designed; recommends mine-and-freeze — lift the interactive-serving core + agent contract into the Hub, retire the standalone SaaS — with the named trigger that would flip it to a temporary headless revival.

rfcs.name: rfc-podcast-primitive
rfcs.description: The podcast primitive — a composable renderer that turns an expert's agentsfs knowledge into one high-quality episode; extraction plan, contract, and cost.

rfcs.name: rfc-portfolio-architecture
rfcs.description: The capstone architecture for the whole SeekingGradient portfolio — one organism built in installments, its organs classified into seven composition forms with membership rules, API surfaces, and maintenance tiers; the convergence thesis (brain × surfaces × delivery) with K Street Health Brief as the worked example; the federated-KB-with-HQ knowledge architecture; an evidence-gated extraction sequence that never wobbles the live product; and a light-touch monetization posture. Deepens seekinggradient-hq/portfolio.md into the composition architecture.

rfcs.name: rfc-slides-primitive
rfcs.description: A composable slides renderer for the SeekingGradient portfolio — a design-constrained agent that turns an approved content packet + a design profile into an excellent open-slide deck (embeddable SPA + PPTX + PNGs), reliably at the Kauai bar.
